hook: Content note: this page sits behind an adult-content gate and is explicitly sexual throughout, with references to violence in its historical documents. The anomaly is an ancient fertility goddess who stays awake only while she is worshipped, and the Foundation has had to get creative about supplying that worship. The frank material is played mostly for deadpan comedy.
whyItMatters: SCP-4960 is a rare example of a highly rated article that builds its entire premise around sexuality while keeping the tone dry and bureaucratic. It also features Maria Jones of RAISA in an exasperated email exchange that pokes fun at the article's own embarrassing procedures. The attached historical documents push it beyond a one-joke entry into a period piece about a 1920s excavation.
thingsToNotice:
The main file is satire of procedure: budgets, sockpuppet accounts, demographic surveys and staff complaints, all applied with a straight face to a deeply awkward requirement. The inventory list of the chamber rewards attention, since several items quietly hint at the goddess's older, more martial side.

The diary of the expedition leader changes the register entirely; it is an adventure narrative told by a narrator whose period prejudices are on full display and are clearly not the article's own. The letters and statements that follow are best read in the order given.
